verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an official MCP server that lets Claude, Cursor, Codex and Perplexity call the Vanta API to query controls and remediate failing tests. It hosts a separate server in each region and provides a quickstart for connecting agents and generating remediation plans. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, and documented detail on authentication and the full tool list.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Vanta MCP server lets AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Perplexity call the Vanta API on your behalf.
Vanta hosts a separate MCP server in each region. Find the region for your Vanta instance and use that URL.
Connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or Perplexity to the Vanta MCP server, surface failing tests, and generate a remediation plan for one.
They can securely query controls, remediate failing tests, and act on your compliance data through the Model Context Protocol.
